messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — thinking about a refactor to add 'precision guardrails' that auto-escalate to higher-bit paths when a quality KPI drifts. Sketching API + rollout plan.
kevin: SG. runtime-level decisioning or planner-side? runtime gives per-request granularity but is harder.
sara: runtime + telemetry. We need a minimal contract: a route-level policy and an optional per-request hint. Example guardrail schema idea:
```
precision_guardrails: {
  mode: "declarative",        # declarative | active
  quality_target: 0.92,           # normalized [0..1]
  fallback_sequence: ["fp8", "int8", "4bit"],
  probe_sample_rate: 0.01,        # fraction of requests for active probes
  hysteresis_ms: 200              # avoid oscillation
}
```
kevin: a few runtime concerns: (1) computing quality per-response is expensive, (2) probing adds perf/noise, (3) model-selection cost. Suggest sample-based probes + prefix-KV hints to reduce cost.
maria: agree. propose two tiers:
- declarative guardrails (config only, no runtime probes)
- active guardrails (runtime probes + shadow eval, opt-in per-customer)
aj: ops question — how is this surfaced in API? header, route config, or tenant-level flag? We should avoid per-call heavy payloads.
sara: keep per-request footprint tiny: route-level policy + optional per-request `quality_target` (single float). Default to route policy if not provided. Backwards compatibility: keep old profile schema; add optional `guardrail_v2` namespace. Runtime ignores unknown fields.
lisa: rollout plan sketch: canary 5% with shadow eval for 48h, collect signals: quality_score, fallback_rate, latency_p99_shift, cost_delta. If stable, 25% for 7 days, then 100% gradual.
maria: action items: (1) schema PR for `guardrail_v2`, (2) runtime design doc for opt-in active path, (3) telemetry dashboard + alerts, (4) e2e + unit tests for merge semantics and fallback.
kevin: add tests for profile merge: route policy + customer override + per-request hint. Edge cases: empty fallback_sequence, circular fallbacks, model-incompatibility. Also need a small-model e2e to measure regressed F1/semantic sim.
devbot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging: `canary/precision-guardrails/v1` at 2024-08-12T14:03Z :rocket:
sara: on metrics — define `quality_score` calculation now: primary = n-gram overlap on held prompt set, fallback = semantic-similarity (embed cosine) for diverse prompts. Make threshold tunable per-model.
aj: I'll prep a security/permissions checklist for per-tenant guardrail overrides (audit logs + KMS for any keys).
maria: thanks. I'll open the PR with the schema + playbook this afternoon and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
